note: This profile documents which existing, tested GLEW mechanisms would become the sole language authority once ratified and wired into production. It does not itself grant full_glew_language_commit_authority -- that flag stays false in GLEW_UPSTREAM_PROFILE_v1.json until Steps 2-9 of the governing spec are built, proven, and separately cut over. This file contains no response content, vocabulary, target phrases, desired test results, or tuned thresholds.

upstream_profile.canonicalization: json.dumps(value, allow_nan=False, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + newline, per genesis.py
upstream_profile.verified: raw file bytes equal the canonical form exactly; digest computed directly against the live file, not asserted

five_sense_chemistry_profile.canonicalization: json.dumps(value, separators=(',',':'), sort_keys=True), file is canonical_body + trailing newline, per story_chemistry.py
verified_anti_patterns_absent: no port derived from a word label or hash (confirmed zero derivation logic in story_chemistry.py / story_native_replay.py)
no hardcoded sight/sound precedence over touch/smell/taste (PRODUCTION_STORY_PORT_LANES is alphabetic and used only for exact-set membership, never ordering)

replay_case_kinds.BASE: same event replayed with zero perturbation; keeps the pre-replay stream's own evidence_id and receipt exactly
replay_case_kinds.SENSOR_ADJACENT_CODE: one directed adjacent perturbation of a sensor coordinate; always gets a distinct, non-matching evidence_id
replay_case_kinds.LANGUAGE_TYPED_TRIT: one directed +/-1 perturbation of a single language-trit coordinate; always gets a distinct, non-matching evidence_id

typed_language.counterfactual_guard: only BASE reuses the original evidence_id; any other kind's distinct evidence_id makes its sealed receipt structurally unable to match a real coexperienced output's source_stream_receipt_sha256 (verified directly, not assumed)

expression_mode.recognition_mechanism: certified reciprocal/dual-basis solve over the raw (never orthogonalized) stored source vectors -- order-independent by construction, not the earlier order-biased Gram-Schmidt projection

entropy_disposition.verified: zero references to ENTROPY_OPERATOR_ID or modes.py from expression_modes.py or commit.py
entropy_disposition.rationale: expression distinction is governed by certified full-field residual growth, unique interval dominance, Global-UF, L5 applicability, and L6 -- entropy is not required and must not be reintroduced as a language authority

safe_mode.rule: exact fail-closed meet over a mounted, signed required_fact_ids set; any FAULT -> FAIL; any missing/duplicate/extra/UNKNOWN fact -> UNKNOWN; only all-CLEAR -> PASS; no defaults, scores, or timeouts

event_support.full_rank_rule: exact Gram determinant over all mounted non-language ports; requires complete interval + at least 4 lived lanes; rank/lane shortfall zeroes geometry rather than fabricating a value
event_support.exterior_receipt_rule: reports exact rank and per-subset normalized volume for every nonempty port subset from the identical mounted evidence; does not select, average, or threshold ports; does not change the full-rank fail-closed behavior
event_support.confirmed_structural_finding: a single closed-experience boundary genuinely produces rank 3 of 5 (25 of 31 subsets non-degenerate even though the full 5-port determinant is exactly zero) -- verified by direct experiment with genuinely distinct per-lane parameters, not a fixture artifact

global_uf.rule: binary structural-replay-consistency authority: every required adjacent-state replay must exactly byte-match the BASE replay's structural payload; any mismatch -> FAIL, any unresolved replay -> UNKNOWN, all-match -> PASS; not a scoring function

fixed42_l6.rule: language is never wrapped as a continuous replay bundle and is never averaged, selected, normalized, scored, or otherwise reduced; the five continuous sensory lanes and the discrete typed-language cone are bound into one immutable six-lane assembly receipt

l5_applicability.mechanism_confirmed_real: schema, receipts, coverage checks, and UNKNOWN/FAIL propagation into commit are fully wired (commit.py L5Applicability, closed_experience.py MountedL5GovernanceProfile/L5ApplicabilityRule)
l5_applicability.gap: no ratified rule exists for when a native port is genuinely inapplicable; every known test/call site sets every port/fact to REQUIRED; NOT_APPLICABLE has never been exercised
l5_applicability.proposed_starting_rule_for_ratification_: a port becomes NOT_APPLICABLE only when its underlying sensor is verifiably absent or disconnected at the hardware/interface level -- never merely quiet. A present-but-quiet sensor stays REQUIRED and must evolve through natural decay, per section 9.4 of the governing spec.

commit.decision_rule: any unknown finding -> UNKNOWN_NO_COMMIT; else any negative finding -> NO_COMMIT; else -> COMMIT

requires: registry is a strict append-only extension
state is not terminal and has a pending_relation
caller's prior_relation is byte-identical to state.pending_relation
CommittedCoexperience.verify() matches every embedded receipt digest between the commit and the sealed experience
learning.counterfactual_guard_verified: CoexperiencedOutput.verify() rejects any typed scalar whose sealed source_stream_receipt_sha256 does not exactly match the original pre-replay capture; a genuinely perturbed replay case cannot satisfy this by construction, confirmed directly

output_binding.rule: a binding must contain exactly one scalar and zero no-output facts, or exactly one no-output fact and zero scalars -- enforced at construction, not by convention
output_binding.sensory_citation_rule: a motif-output binding must cite the closed experience's complete non-language sensory receipts; it cannot be free-floating from the coexperienced senses

fresh_recall.exact_close_gate: a released settlement (status EXPRESSION_RELEASED) is the only settlement kind that may carry visible_text or emitted_scalar_codepoints; every other settlement kind structurally cannot, enforced in output.py's _output_settlement_receipt_payload -- confirmed a real enforced gate by passing tamper/fragment-leak tests, not descriptive text only

distinct_concepts_do_not_conflate: genesis.py: genesis of the ratified upstream GLEW executable profile / field-operator bundle (schema glew.upstream.genesis.v1, kind clean_generation_genesis)
expression_learning.py: genesis of LearnedBindingState (create_learned_binding_genesis, HMAC-SHA256 signed checkpoint)
deployment_generation.py / immutable_generation_store.py: EFS-backed deployment-sealing/materialization, unrelated to GLEW cognition state
hard_fail_assertions_confirmed_current: profile.downstream.field_evolution must match the field-operator status
clean genesis requires an unused root; existing state is never imported (_require_unused_root)

prohibitions: a canned response for hello, identity questions, or any validation prompt
a question/answer table or context-indexed dialogue script
a vocabulary lookup as semantic or emission authority
a weighted sum of DSF fields
lowering a commit threshold until tests pass
selecting the most frequent or highest-scoring candidate
converting absent sensory evidence into invented values
generating sight, sound, touch, smell, or taste from a word hash
treating static descriptor dictionaries as lived sensory truth
an LLM, embedding model, classifier, or probabilistic language model
Shannon entropy as GLEW mode or commit authority
importing legacy derived Atlas state into clean GLEW state
a second ECS service, alternate production, audit shadow, or background writer
tests that return False instead of asserting the required result
test fixtures or monkeypatches presented as proof of the production path

expression-mode operator IDs (recommended: ratify as-is, per expression_mode above -- already fixed and verified)
commit conjunction (recommended: ratify as-is, per commit above -- verified no threshold/score/vote)
coexperienced Unicode output and exact-close release (recommended: ratify as-is, per fresh_recall above -- verified real enforced gate)

L5 applicability rule for genuinely-unavailable ports (open gap -- see l5_applicability.proposed_starting_rule_for_ratification_only_not_authoritative; requires explicit sign-off, this is a real design decision, not a technical formality)
clean education source and acceptable seed provenance (not addressed in this profile -- content/policy decision, requires explicit sign-off)

conversational latency SLO as a product constraint, separate from cognition physics (not addressed in this profile -- product decision, requires explicit sign-off; governing spec proposes a starting candidate of first-response under 2s / p95 under 5s for already-learned turns)
